reviews.text: I took my dog ​​to Pollop and was truly satisfied. The staff is very professional, kind, and attentive to the animals' well-being. The grooming was performed with great care and precision, leaving my dog ​​clean, smelling fresh, and perfectly groomed. You can tell they work with passion and love for animals. Highly recommended!

I've always gone to Pollop, and in my opinion, they're the best, both for my Australian Shepherd's coat care and for their empathy for animals. They recently introduced a keratin and snail slime treatment, which is a real game-changer.

What can I say?
The best.

I've been going to Pollop for 4 years, ever since my poodle Theo was a puppy, and I've never considered changing. I trust Luca's professionalism, patience, and kindness. He always manages to please me and, above all, treats Theo with love and attention. One aspect I truly appreciate is the organic products used, which keep Theo's coat beautiful and healthy. Last but not least, the quality treats Luca offers his furry clients, carefully selected for the well-being of our four-legged friends.

Luca, keep it up and never change!

I've been taking my Siberian cat Kiki to Luca for over three years now and I'm incredibly satisfied. Luca is an expert professional: he can groom my cat without gloves, and Kiki lets him wash and comb her for a long time without resisting. Luca is a truly wonderful person, and I can highly recommend him to anyone who loves their pets and wants the best for them.
Luca is a person who has so much passion for animals, especially with my dog ​​Tyson; he always leaves him clean and smelling nice.
Was in Milano for work and Lulu said she was desperate for a bath & trim. Luca took us at late notice on a Friday. He was brilliant. Highly recommended!

I found Luca while surfing the internet looking for a professional Maltese groomer. Before bringing Archie, I called him and asked him countless questions, which he patiently answered reassuringly.
Yesterday I brought my 7-month-old Maltese and was pleasantly surprised by his professionalism and the great patience he showed Archie. The keratin and snail slime treatment he used left his fur soft and shiny.
Extremely satisfied, Luca, you're the 🔝

Today I took my Cocker Spaniel, Chanel, to Luca. I'm absolutely thrilled with the grooming service!!! Chanel was not only beautiful and smelling great, but also calm and serene, despite her somewhat agitated nature. I really appreciate the use of organic and natural products, a real blessing for her healthy coat and skin. Thanks to Luca, who takes care of Chanel with care and professionalism. Highly recommended!!!
I took my Yorkie to Luca and was extremely satisfied. I appreciated his professionalism, attention to detail, and the kindness with which he made my little dog feel at ease. Highly recommended.
Luca is a true professional, you can see he does this job with passion and love, highly recommended!

I went to Luca's for the first time with my French Bulldog! I had a great time 🤩Luca took care of my little one like he was his own! Excellent service, I will go back and recommend him to my friends. …
Very welcoming salon, competent manager and excellent quality dog ​​products. The grooming is done with competence and aesthetic taste.

I've been taking my Golden Retriever to Luca since he was a puppy, and I couldn't be happier with the service! Incredibly professional, kind, and passionate about his work. He always makes my pup feel at ease, and every time he leaves, he smells great and is perfectly groomed! I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and loving place for their four-legged friends!
We're very happy with Luca. He's very reliable, precise, and caring. We've been happy to leave our cats with him whenever they need him for the past three years.
Super patient and professional👍👍 …
Well done, my dog ​​is long-haired and has never been so soft and with such a neat and well-done cut.
Excellent, very knowledgeable, and attentive to the dog's personality. I brought my older, very shy Chihuahua, and he handled the grooming with precision and gentleness. Top!
Excellent service, very kind and super knowledgeable about dogs, I recommend it!
I had my dog ​​groomed by Luca, an incredible professional who uses natural and hypoallergenic products, attentive and meticulous, for the first time my dog ​​stayed clean for a long time.

Luca is a good boy, unfortunately I don't think poodles are his forte. I wasn't happy with the cut. I asked for a round face and not a straight cut, and he gave her some biscuits (without asking if he could have them) which caused diarrhea that same evening. I'm attaching photos of her before and after the grooming.
Luca is always very attentive to our four-legged treasures in every aspect - a nice person and the products he uses for their well-being are excellent.
